questions.question: When Paul defended being an apostle to the Corinthians, whom did he say he had seen?
Paul had the right to be supported by the Corinthians but put up with anything instead. Why?

answers.text: So he wouldn't hinder the gospel of Christ
So no one in Corinth would call him greedy
So the Corinthians would owe him even more

questions.question: Paul said that though he was free of obligation to anyone, he made himself a slave to everyone. True or false?
Paul said athletes in the games train for a crown. How is the crown that believers train for different?
